title: I've been making a bike game/training simulator for smart trainers based on real trails/routes.
author: Gelliman
selftext:
The clip here from trails and routes in Moab, Big Sur, Mallorca, San Clemente, Auburn. 

Some backstory on the idea: I was training for a mountain bike race in Downieville CA but live pretty far away and wanted to get an idea of how my fitness was for the climb. So I started playing around with claude, unreal and my smart trainer (I use a Wahoo Kickr Core 2). Kind of long story short, this is the result this far. Been very fun to see what is possible now. 

It's gone through a lot of iterations and certainly wasn't a straight path. Still not quite where I want it to be, but getting happier with the results and hoping to have some others test it out soon. If helpful for others, I found the gauntlet loop and wayfinder pretty useful for keeping it organized. 

Got a lot of inspiration from this sub throughout the build, so figured I'd share.

Looks awesome man, great job. You think it can be converted to VR? Maybe not so easy with Unreal. I been dying to get better VR cycle routes to use with my smart bike. I made a velodrome (see vid). Is Cap formentor the Mallorca route? 

https://reddit.com/link/pchjxzf/video/okgs4wv0w5sh1/player

replies.author: Gelliman
replies.body:
Thanks! That video is super interesting! It's definitely something I want to experiment with soon. I've got a Quest 3 I can test it out on. My hope is that I can get it to scale to a wide variety of devices, like a full gaming rig with VR to just a basic iPhone. So far that's proved to be possible with some obvious quality concessions. 

I'll for sure update you if I get a build working on VR.
